findings.text: the node's own census ranks _backends._cached_stream_entry at 42.7 % of 832,032,759 bytes above the 19.5 % recovery_memo._newest_result_event row at :461 that the diff repairs, so the dominant read the goal names survives the change and only the second-ranked reader was made incremental.

the done_when's live conjunct (under 20 MB/min and under 5 % of one core) is recorded as not met in both arms at :517-518, 1,131 MB/min and 92.5 % of one core at base 73a771c against 1,376 MB/min and 75.4 % with the cursor, so a named clause of the node's own measure is unmet rather than merely unrecorded.

the census that names the dominant read windows 40 s over 147 live pointers while the done_when names a 60 s window, and the second census at logs/station-read-census-45s.txt windows 45 s, so neither log is the window the measure specifies.
commit 622fd58737 adds the count keyword to _stream_lines_from in a file the declared write paths do not cover, so the change reached outside its fence for a signature it needed.

commit 157e612e11 rewrites this pre-existing test's cursor store from a plain dict to an OrderedDict, and the declared write paths name only tests/test_the_station_reads_only_what_changed.py among the test files, so a sibling's guard was edited to fit this node's store type.

the fragment's h3 ids (station-cursor-census, station-cursor-fixture, station-cursor-counter, station-cursor-arms, station-cursor-remaining) do not begin with the node id, which the landing contract requires of every element id so composed sibling fragments cannot claim the same anchor.

it says none of the remaining readers is reachable from this node's write scope, but reckon/file_memo.py was a declared path of this node and its content_digest is 12.4 % of the census at docs/research/monitor-storage-load-rca.html:462.

the cursor store keeps its own identity/offset/head bookkeeping beside _PARSED_STREAMS at reckon/_backends.py:3651 rather than extending that owner's resume mechanism; the byte read, the head sample and its check are the owner's, but the store is a second implementation of the same idea, kept separate because the owner's 32 MB eviction is the residual defect this node names under outside_scope.

no test drives the branch where the inode is unchanged and the size is not smaller but the opening bytes moved: the pre-existing replaced-stream case at tests/test_producer_reads_only_what_changed.py:234 moves the inode and its truncated case shrinks the size, so deleting the _stream_head_intact conjunct would leave every arm green while a rewritten stream resumed into bytes it never held.
